title: zazzle-csharp-indexer content analysis component diagram
description: From bytes to stored blob facts, and the literal extraction that lets search use the Bloom filters. Everything here is a static function of its input.

components.name: Content analysis
components.responsibility: Everything zazzle-csharp-indexer derives from a file's bytes.

components.name: Blob analyser (BlobAnalyzer.cs)
components.responsibility: Git blob id, language from the extension, binary test (a NUL in the first 8 KiB), line count, digest; calls the filter and the extractors.

components.name: Trigram Bloom filter (Bloom.cs)
components.responsibility: Builds a per-blob filter of ASCII-lowercased byte trigrams and tests whether all of a query's trigrams may be present.

components.name: C# extractor (CSharpSymbols.cs)
components.responsibility: Declarations and identifier tokens from a Roslyn syntax tree, without compiling.

components.name: Heuristic extractor (HeuristicSymbols.cs)
components.responsibility: Per-line regex rules for Rust, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, Java, GDScript, shell, Markdown headings, Swift and C/C++, and word-based identifier tables for code languages.

components.name: Regex literal extractor (RegexLiterals.cs)
components.responsibility: The literal runs every match of a pattern must contain, conservatively: none when unsure.

components.name: Symbol format (Sym.cs)
components.responsibility: The Sym record and the compact JSON stored for symbols and identifier occurrences.

components.name: Roslyn C# syntax (NuGet Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp)
components.responsibility: C# parser, used in process for syntax trees only.

relationships.description: The entry point the engine calls.
Builds the filter for every text blob.
For language csharp, up to 2 MiB.
For every other language, up to 2 MiB.
Serialises symbols and identifiers for the store.
